enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running on low to cope with the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull sheet over shoulder. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Pull sheet down. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull sheet up.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting changed into work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Splash water on face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth and spit. Turn off tap. Put toothbrush down. Put on work clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a quick breakfast, boiling water in the kettle and toasting bread, drinking extra water ahead of the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Take kettle. Fill with water. Plug in. Turn on kettle. Open fridge. Take out bread. Open toaster. Insert bread. Press lever. Take glass and fill with water. Drink water. Pour water into cup. Take toast. Eat breakfast. Drink water. Turn off light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a long hospital shift as a health care professional, caring for patients and staying hydrated during the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Take vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Record notes. Wash hands. Drink water. Go to nurses' station. Answer phone. Consult with doctor. Wash hands. Eat lunch. Drink water. Continue rounds. Handover to next shift. Walk to locker room. Change out of scrubs. Walk out of hospital.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner with the induction cooker and eating it while avoiding air-conditioner use during the evening peak
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on cooker. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Cook. Turn off cooker. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to wash off the day and cool down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water. Adjust temperature to cool. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clean clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with the fan on and watching TV, keeping the air conditioner off until the peak period ends
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust fan speed. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Leave living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding in bed, checking the phone and doing a little reading by the desk lamp, switching on the air conditioner now that the peak has passed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll. Put phone down. Pick up book. Turn on desk lamp. Read book. Turn off desk lamp. Pick up remote. Turn on AC. Adjust temperature. Lie down. Close eyes. Breathe.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner set to a moderate temperature and the light off
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Pull sheet over body. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Pull sheet down. Adjust pillow position. Lie on back. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull sheet up.
